peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Price position
positions.bandLabel: Higher relative price than most peers
positions.statement: Price position — Higher relative price than most peers: 21.6% above its local comparables; 32 of 34 similar developments with a figure have a lower relative price (a position, not a measure of value).

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (44.3): 3.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 18 of 44 similar developments (the same as 3). Context, not scored: resales in 66.7% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments
lines.statement: 1-bedroom: median $1,662,500 ($2,271 psf, 710–753 sq ft; 8 resales, Jan 2024–Dec 2025); 8 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,809 psf (range $1,625–2,245); 25.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $338,000 more. 2-bedroom: median $2,320,000 ($2,155 psf, 1,054–1,227 sq ft; 13 resales, Aug 2024–Jul 2026); 7 comparable developments within 3 km: median $2,042 psf (range $1,822–2,313); 5.5% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $122,000 more. 3-bedroom: median $3,900,000 ($2,384 psf, 1,636–1,980 sq ft; 5 resales, Feb 2024–Jan 2026); 5 comparable developments within 3 km: median $1,857 psf (range $1,796–2,198); 28.4% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $862,000 more. 4-bedroom: median $6,000,000 ($2,522 psf, 2,368–2,378 sq ft; 5 resales, Jul 2024–Jun 2026); 5 comparable developments within 5 km: median $1,985 psf (range $1,451–3,323); 27.1% above; illustrative entry-price difference about $1,278,000 more. The entry-price difference is illustrative: the median price adjusted to the comparable median psf, for a similar-size unit. A premium or a discount is not in itself an advantage or a disadvantage.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: No first resale wave in the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Downtown MRT about 210 m, Marina Bay MRT about 260 m; closer than 23 of 44 similar developments (the same as 1). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 0 within 1 km and 0 within 2 km; nearest River Valley Primary School about 2,680 m; more than 0 of 44 similar developments (the same as 28). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 4 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 40 m), more than 14 of 44 similar developments (the same as 3); nearest hawker centre Market Street Hawker Centre about 730 m; nearest park Raffles Place Park about 520 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (W Residences Marina View - Singapore, 14 new sales, about 660 m; Skywaters Residences, 5 new sales, about 960 m; One Marina Gardens, 149 new sales, about 980 m; TMW Maxwell, 1 new sales, about 1,150 m; Newport Residences, 203 new sales, about 1,450 m; Union Square Residences, 106 new sales, about 1,580 m; Canninghill Piers, 8 new sales, about 1,720 m; Midtown Bay, 4 new sales, about 1,880 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 44 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 490 new sales and 306 resales (796 purchases); new sales were 61.6% of these purchases. Subsales (33) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: No site within 2 km in the known list. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Quiet area: local resales are among the lowest 30% of similar developments, so little nearby competition reflects a thin market, not an advantage. 306 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 12 of 44 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 306 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 321 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−4.7%). Planning-area private resales −0.3%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
